attempted_claim: Let F be a saturated fusion system on a finite p-group S with unique minimal F-characteristic (S,S)-biset Lambda_F. Let P <= S and K <= Aut(P) with either K <= Inn(P) or K >= Inn(P), and assume P is fully K-normalized in F. Put N = N_F^K(P) and let N_{Lambda_F}^K(P) be the K-normalizer subbiset. Is N_{Lambda_F}^K(P) = Lambda_N, the minimal N-characteristic biset, even when P is not F-centric? In particular, for fully normalized resp. centralized noncentric P, do N_{Lambda_F}(P) = Lambda_{N_F(P)} and C_{Lambda_F}(P) = Lambda_{C_F(P)} hold?
decisive_failure: The investigation reached a documented impasse rather than a resolution: the general proof is blocked at the centricity hypotheses of the Puig extension results and the centric-orbit classification, and computational falsification was verified only in two small instances (D8 center, V4/A4) plus Heisenberg setup. No claim about the truth or falsity of the conjecture in general is made, and the instance scripts are supporting evidence only.
